basic_details.job_title: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 24,752 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Department of Local Self Government (DLB Rajasthan) Sanvida Safai Karmachari Notification 2026 has been released under Advertisement No. 01/2026 on the official website. A total of 24,752 vacancies have been announced through the DLB Rajasthan Sanvida Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026.

application_fee.details: Under the One Time Registration (OTR) system introduced via the Personnel Department circular dated 19 April 2023, candidates must pay the OTR registration fee once through their SSO ID via authorised e-Mitra kiosks or Jan Suvidha Kendras before applying. | Candidates who have already paid the One Time Registration fee in an earlier recruitment do not need to pay it again.

age_limit.details: As on 1 January 2027, the candidate must have completed 21 years of age and must not have exceeded 40 years of age, as per the provisions of the Rajasthan Contractual Hiring to Civil Posts Rules, 2022. | Important: Age relaxation benefits under the various categories above are non-cumulative — a candidate can avail the relaxation under only one applicable provision, not a combination of multiple provisions. As per Rajasthan Service Rules, the retirement age for government employees is 60 years; hence a candidate's age must not exceed 60 years as on the date of appointment.

qualification.details: No specific educational qualification has been prescribed for the post of Sanvida Safai Karmachari. Candidates only need to fulfil the experience criteria mentioned below.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be engaged on a contract basis and paid a monthly honorarium of Rs. 7,410/-, as notified by the Labour Department, Government of Rajasthan, vide notification dated 13 December 2024.

selection_process: There is no written examination for this recruitment. Selection to the post of Sanvida Safai Karmachari will be made purely through a lottery system
conducted using online software developed by the Department of Information Technology and Communication
category-wise as per the number of vacancies advertised for each ULB.
The lottery process will follow this order of priority:
candidates possessing 1 year of sanitation work experience in the same ULB (for which they applied) will be included in the lottery. If posts remain vacant after step 1
candidates with 1 year of sanitation work experience in any other ULB of the same district will be included. If posts still remain vacant after steps 1 and 2
candidates with 1 year of sanitation work experience in any ULB across the state will be included in the lottery.
how_to_apply: Visit the official portal https://lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in/ or the Rajasthan SSO portal https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in.
Log in using your SSO ID and select "Recruitment Portal" under Citizen Apps (G2C).
Click on "Apply Now" for the Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026.
If you have not completed One Time Registration (OTR) earlier, complete it first by selecting your category (Unreserved/Reserved), disability status, and home state, and pay the applicable OTR fee.
Proceed to fill the detailed application form with personal details, category, ULB preference (only one ULB can be selected), and experience details.
Upload the required documents including the experience certificate, caste/EWS/disability certificates as applicable.
Capture a live photograph as instructed and upload your scanned signature or thumb impression.
Carefully review all entries in the preview stage, since corrections are not allowed after final submission in most fields.
Submit the application and note down the Application ID generated after submission.
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: A candidate can apply to only one urban local body out of the 183 notified ULBs. Applying to more than one ULB, or submitting more than one application for the same ULB, will result in rejection of all applications submitted by that candidate. Details entered during OTR (name, father's name, date of birth, gender, and ID proof) cannot be modified later; candidates should verify their Aadhaar/Jan Aadhaar details for accuracy before registering. Candidates registering via SSO ID (instead of Aadhaar/Jan Aadhaar) must additionally upload their secondary mark sheet and an identity document. Only the candidate's own mobile number and email ID should be used, since all important communication will be sent to these details. Marriage registration is mandatory for appointment to Rajasthan government service as per the Home Department circular dated 22 May 2006. Offline applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. Selected candidates will need to submit a medical fitness certificate and undergo police verification before final appointment. Candidates should keep checking the official website regularly for updates related to this recruitment.

Candidates preparing for state-level contractual and government recruitments can also explore more Rajasthan Government Jobs and Nagar Nikay Bharti Updates across various departments. Those looking for similar sanitation and civic body vacancies can check Municipal Corporation Jobs in India for upcoming openings. content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Vacancy 2026 - ULB-wise Details
content_sections.text: The 24,752 posts are distributed across 183 urban local bodies of Rajasthan, divided into non-scheduled area ULBs (24,277 posts) and scheduled area ULBs (475 posts). Candidates must check the category-wise breakup for their preferred ULB on the official website before applying, since reservation is applicable as per state rules. Note: The vacancy count for each ULB may increase or decrease as per the competent authority's discretion. Candidates should verify the latest category-wise vacancy breakup on the official website https://lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in/ before applying, since reservation benefits apply as per prevailing rules.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a domicile of Rajasthan. Nationality: Indian citizen, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, and the United Republic of Tanzania comprising former Tanganyika and Zanzibar), Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, or Ethiopia with the intention of permanently settling in India. For applicants under categories (b) to (e) above, a certificate of eligibility issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, must be submitted.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Bharti 2026 - Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: No specific educational qualification has been prescribed for the post of Sanvida Safai Karmachari. Candidates only need to fulfil the experience criteria mentioned below.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026 - Experience Requirement
content_sections.text: Candidates must have at least 1 year of experience in sanitation work in any urban local body of Rajasthan to be eligible. This 1-year experience can be either continuous or accumulated in separate spells that together total 1 year. The experience certificate must be issued in the prescribed format by: The Chief Municipal Officer (or an officer authorised by them), if the candidate was directly employed by the urban local body; or The contractor/authorised agency (in case of contract-based deployment), duly counter-signed by the concerned senior manager/chief manager of solid waste at the ULB, and further countersigned by the Chief Municipal Officer (for Municipal Councils/Boards) or the Deputy Commissioner (Personnel)/Commissioner-authorised officer not below the rank of Deputy Commissioner (for Municipal Corporations). Experience certificates must be issued on or after 1 August 2026 and before the last date of submission of the application; certificates issued before this date will not be accepted. The format of the experience certificate is available on the departmental portal https://lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in/. Strict legal action will be taken against applicants, agencies, or issuing authorities found submitting fake experience certificates.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 1 January 2027, the candidate must have completed 21 years of age and must not have exceeded 40 years of age, as per the provisions of the Rajasthan Contractual Hiring to Civil Posts Rules, 2022. Important: Age relaxation benefits under the various categories above are non-cumulative — a candidate can avail the relaxation under only one applicable provision, not a combination of multiple provisions. As per Rajasthan Service Rules, the retirement age for government employees is 60 years; hence a candidate's age must not exceed 60 years as on the date of appointment.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari 2026 - Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged on a contract basis and paid a monthly honorarium of Rs. 7,410/-, as notified by the Labour Department, Government of Rajasthan, vide notification dated 13 December 2024.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Bharti 2026 - Application Fee (OTR Registration Fee)
content_sections.text: Under the One Time Registration (OTR) system introduced via the Personnel Department circular dated 19 April 2023, candidates must pay the OTR registration fee once through their SSO ID via authorised e-Mitra kiosks or Jan Suvidha Kendras before applying. Candidates who have already paid the One Time Registration fee in an earlier recruitment do not need to pay it again.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026 - Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, More Backward Classes, and Economically Weaker Sections is applicable as per prevailing Rajasthan Government norms (vertical reservation). Women: 30% horizontal reservation, category-wise. Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan): 4% horizontal reservation. Ex-servicemen: 15% horizontal reservation. Outstanding sportspersons: 2% horizontal reservation. Reservation for candidates from the Sahariya primitive tribe of Baran district is applicable as per government orders, subject to clear declaration in the online application form. Candidates from states other than Rajasthan belonging to SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS categories will be treated as General category candidates.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination for this recruitment. Selection to the post of Sanvida Safai Karmachari will be made purely through a lottery system, conducted using online software developed by the Department of Information Technology and Communication, Government of Rajasthan, category-wise as per the number of vacancies advertised for each ULB. The lottery process will follow this order of priority: First, candidates possessing 1 year of sanitation work experience in the same ULB (for which they applied) will be included in the lottery. If posts remain vacant after step 1, candidates with 1 year of sanitation work experience in any other ULB of the same district will be included. If posts still remain vacant after steps 1 and 2, candidates with 1 year of sanitation work experience in any ULB across the state will be included in the lottery.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Bharti 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Aadhaar Card / Jan Aadhaar Card (used for OTR registration) Caste certificate (issued by competent authority, in prescribed format), where applicable OBC/MBC non-creamy layer certificate with correct residence and creamy-layer details SC/ST certificate issued before the last date of the application EWS Income & Assets Certificate (in prescribed format), where applicable Disability (UDID) certificate for Divyangjan candidates, issued by an authorised medical board/college superintendent Sanitation work experience certificate (dated after 1 August 2026 and before the last application date) Marriage registration certificate (mandatory for appointment to government service) Live photograph captured during the online application (photo editing/tampering is not permitted) Scanned signature/thumb impression as per the specified format (JPEG, 20KB-50KB)
